(def array-index-of-keyword?
  (fn [^objects arr k]
  ;; Keywords are interned (#361): one of the same name is the same value,
  ;; so the scan compares identity, as JVM Clojure's does (#442).
  (let [len (alength arr)]
    (loop [i 0]
      (cond
        (<= len i) -1
        (suss.bootstrap/same-reference? k (aget arr i)) i
        :else (recur (+ i 2)))))))
